simple.meaning: יִרְאָה (yirʼâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 42 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, 2 Samuel, 2 Chronicles, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 20:11. Its contexts include faith, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יִרְאָה (H3374).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God, because of the reproach of the nations our enemies?

definitions.full: H3374. yirah יִרְאָה noun feminine fear ; — ׳יר Ezek 30:13 6 t.; construct יִרְאַת Gen 20:11 27t.; suffix יִרְאָתִי Jer 32:40 ; יִרְאָתוֺ Exod 20:20 ; יִרְאָֽתְךָ Job 4:6 3 t.; יִרְאָתֶ֑ךָ Psa 5:8 2 t.; — 1 fear, terror Isa 7:25 ; Ezek 30:13 ; ׳י גְדוֺלָה great fear Jonah 1:10 , 16 ; || מַּחַד Deut 2:25 ; || רעד(הׅ Psa 2:11 ; 55:6 . 2 a terror = object of terror , || גֹּבַהּ Ezek 1:18 (strike out Co). 3 fear of God, reverence, piety אֱלֹהִים יִרְאַת Gen 20:11 (E), 2Sam 23:3 ; Neh 5:15 ; ׳יר שַׁדַּי Job 6:14 ; ׳יר אֱלֹהֵינוּ Neh 5:9 ; ׳יר יהוה 2Chr 19:9 ; Isa 11:3 ; 33:6 ; Psa 34:12 ; Prov 10:27 ; 14:26-27 , 15:16 ; 19:23 ; 22:4 ; 23:17 ; || the knowledge (of God) 1:29 ; 2:5 ; Isa 11:2 ; is the beginning of wisdom Psa 111:10 ; Prov 9:10 , and knowledge 1:7 ; the instruction of wisdom 15:33 , is to hate evil 8:13 , and it involves departing from evil 16:6 ; ׳י אֲדֹנָי is wisdom Job 28:28 ; יִרְאָה is defined by context 15:4 ; with suffixes these are usually object, fear of him Exod 20:20 (E), of thee Psa 5:8 ; 90:11 ; 119:38 ; Isa 63:17 , of me Jer 32:40 , but subject, thy fear (i.e. thy religion) Job 4:6 ; 22:4 . 4 יהוֺה יִרְאַת Psa 19:10 the fear of ׳י = the law as revered.
